description: The map u(x) = x/(1+|x|) takes all reals into (−1,1), and v(t) = t/(1−|t|) is its inverse on both domains.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.line_interval_inverse_laws :
  Set.MapsTo Lemmatheca.SetTheory.lineToSymmetricInterval Set.univ (Set.Ioo (-1) 1) ∧
    (∀ (x : ℝ), Lemmatheca.SetTheory.symmetricIntervalToLine (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.lineToSymmetricInterval x) = x) ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-1) 1,
        Lemmatheca.SetTheory.lineToSymmetricInterval (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.symmetricIntervalToLine t) = t
